title: Albert Chow
intro:
Albert Chow is running for election to the San Francisco Board of Supervisors to represent District 4 in California. Chow is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Chow also ran in a special election to the San Francisco Board of Supervisors to represent District 4 in California. Chow lost in the special general election on June 2, 2026.
